source_observation: Swords are fast and versatile; heavy bladed weapons are slower and powerful with sweeping attacks.
design_status: Project tuning, not original Ubisoft numbers. Ratios and weight are our design choices.
role: Melee-focused axe; sword retains higher assassination bonus and critical chance.
limitations: Equipment attribute contributions, not DPS or final hit damage. Weight does not implement attack-speed slowdown. Animation timing and enemy defenses require later combat balancing.
